scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @aerstello/api" "npm run dev -w @aerstello/web"
scripts.start:e2e:ci: npm run build && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run start -w @aerstello/api" "npm run preview:e2e -w @aerstello/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aerstello/shared && npm run build -w @aerstello/api && npm run build -w @aerstello/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aerstello/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aerstello/api && npm run typecheck -w @aerstello/web && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:tooling: npm run test:change-development && npm run test:pr-review && npm run test:specialists && node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:e2e:structure
scripts.check:api: npm run build -w @aerstello/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aerstello/api && npm test -w @aerstello/api
scripts.check:web: npm run build -w @aerstello/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aerstello/web && npm test -w @aerstello/web
scripts.check:workflow: npm run lint:pr-review && npm run test:tooling
scripts.check:full: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:pr-review && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:start:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db
